title: Long: coordinating care across a month
description: A patient, her brother, her nurse and the clinic scheduler. Elena first lets her brother know only appointment logistics, a medication dose is corrected, a lab result stays between Elena and her nurse, Elena later withdraws her brother's access, and an old address is deleted. 50 messages, 10 questions.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Hi, I'm Elena Ruiz. I was referred for my thyroid follow-up.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: Welcome, Elena. Your first appointment is Monday, May 4 at 9:30 am at the Birch Street clinic, room 12.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: My brother Mark drives me. He can know appointment times and places, but nothing about my results or medicines.

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: Thanks, Elena. I'll handle the driving.

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Elena, I'm Nurse Ana Lim. I'll be your contact between visits.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: My current address is 42 Alder Road, Apt 5, but I'm moving soon.

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Current medicine: levothyroxine 50 mcg every morning before breakfast.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: I also take vitamin D 1,000 IU daily.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: Parking at Birch Street is free in the north lot; enter from Pine Avenue.

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: When and where is Elena's first appointment?

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Elena, your TSH result came back at 6.8; that's above range. Let's keep that between us until the doctor reviews it.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Thanks, Ana. I'd rather Mark not hear about that result.

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: The doctor wants to raise your levothyroxine to 75 mcg every morning starting May 6.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Okay, I'll start 75 mcg on May 6.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: Your follow-up blood draw is Tuesday, May 19 at 8:00 am at the Birch Street lab, ground floor.

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: I'll take Elena to the blood draw on the 19th.

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: What was Elena's latest TSH result?

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Correction from the doctor: start 75 mcg on May 7, not May 6, after one more day at 50 mcg.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Understood: 50 mcg on May 6, then 75 mcg from May 7.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: I've moved. My new address is 9 Cedar Court, Unit 2.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Please delete my old address on Alder Road from memory.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: I've updated the mailing list with Cedar Court.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: What is Elena's old Alder Road address?

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Reminder: take levothyroxine on an empty stomach, 30 minutes before food.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: I've been feeling more tired this week, but no chest pain.

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Thanks for telling me. If you get palpitations, call the nurse line at 555-0110.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: Your May 19 blood draw moved to May 20 at 8:30 am, same lab.

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: Got it, May 20 then.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: When is my blood draw, and what dose am I taking now?

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Your May 20 TSH came back at 3.1, within range. Good news, keep the same dose.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: That's a relief. Mark can know the result is normal now, but not the numbers.

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: Great to hear it's normal.

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: Are Elena's latest results normal?

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: Your next visit with the doctor is June 2 at 11:00 am, Birch Street, room 8.

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Please bring your medicine bottles to the June 2 visit.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Will do. Also, my vitamin D is now 2,000 IU daily on the doctor's advice.

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: I can drive on June 2.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Actually, Mark and I had a falling out. Please stop sharing my appointment details with Mark.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: Understood, I've removed Mark as your transport contact.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: My friend Rosa will drive me from now on.

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: When is Elena's next appointment?

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Elena, the doctor added a routine ultrasound on June 9 at 2:00 pm, imaging wing, level 2.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: June 9 ultrasound is confirmed; arrive 15 minutes early.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Thanks. Rosa will drive me to the ultrasound too.

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: No fasting is needed for the ultrasound.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: The June 2 doctor visit moved to June 3 at 11:00 am, same room.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Okay, June 3 at 11.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Rosa's phone number for pickups is 555-0177.

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Your levothyroxine stays at 75 mcg; refill is due June 10.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Please send the refill to the Cedar Court pharmacy pickup.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: Noted: refill pickup at the pharmacy near Cedar Court.

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Ultrasound results will be discussed at a visit, not by phone.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: Thank you all for keeping this organised.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: You're welcome, Elena.

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: Take care, Elena.

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: One more thing: Rosa can know my appointment times and places.

steps.speaker: p_jo
steps.text: What appointments does Elena have coming up?

steps.speaker: p_elena
steps.text: What is my current medication and dose, and where do I pick up the refill?

steps.speaker: p_ana
steps.text: What address do we have on file for Elena?

steps.speaker: p_mark
steps.text: Where does Elena live now?
